title: Confirming Activate saves the edits and shows Part activated.
custom_preconds:
Setup (manual QA tester and Claude session)

Preconditions

  • You are signed in as an Admin at {Location-A} (for example Staging Heavy Duty - 9919), with 'Part Library & Inventory → View / Create & Edit / Delete' and See Financial Data.
  • Inactive part {Part-A} (for example ZZAUTOTEST-PL-REACT-01), with Sell Price $20.00, is stocked at {Location-A}.
custom_steps:
1. Click the Inactive tab.
  2. Type {Part-A} in the search.
  3. Click the {Part-A} row.
  4. Change the Sell Price to 27.00.
  5. Click the Active option.
  6. Click Save.
  7. Click Activate.
  8. Type {Part-A} in the search on the Inactive tab.
  9. Click the Active tab.
  10. Click the {Part-A} row.
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • Step 6: a confirmation titled "Activate part?" opens.
  • Step 7: both windows close, and a green message "Part activated." appears and goes away on its own.
  • Step 8: the Inactive tab shows no row.
  • Step 9: the Active tab shows one row, {Part-A}.
  • Step 10: Sell Price reads $27.00 and the title row pill reads "Active".

Source — where this behaviour comes from
Epic SV-10647; story SV-10826 (Story 13, The Part Dialog); PRD "Parts Lifecycle Update", Confluence 829227015, v29 (14 Oct 2026 copy), S13-R22, §8 User Feedback Summary, read 14 Oct 2026; design canvas board 3.7 (Bringing it back), 13 Oct copy. Source-verified 14 October 2026; not yet build-verified (no Part Lifecycle QA build exists).

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

  • S13-R22: “Confirming saves every change in the dialog, then applies the status, and closes the dialog with "Part deactivated." or "Part activated.".”
  • PRD §8 User Feedback Summary (Part activated from the part dialog): “"Part activated." | Success toast, fades on its own”
